Maigahara Music College Affiliate School Maigahara Senior High (abbreviated MaiMai). At this academy where the most talented musicians from around the country gather, a rumor starts to circulate: Put on a great performance at the school festival and you can earn an extra credit. Believing the rumor to be true, Serina, a student who is in danger of flunking, decides to start a band! Together with Aliciana, Nazuna, Nagi, and Naru, the girls’ world brightens up as they perform, enjoy sleepovers, and even cosplay! But will they be able to perform well enough to earn the rumored credit? The story of a laid-back, everyday girls’ band begins!

The year is 20XX. The ninja, who once forged the history of Japan, were scattered across the country during the Meiji Restoration. As these ninja mingled with the other clans, their bloodline thinned, and they gradually faded from sight. The descendants of these ninja clans, seeking to preserve their heritage, formed the WNA (World Ninja Association) in the hope of carrying on their legacy.

And so it was that the WNA succeeded in developing Ninja-Gum, an art which could summon forth the strength of the Shinobi. And yet creating the most powerful Ninja-Gum requires the strongest of ninja DNA. So it was that the Ninjala Tournament was held, that the mightiest of all ninjas could be found...

Aogami High School collapsed due to undetermined circumstances. Several details of the accident remain mysterious, including reported involvement by numerous students and staff members, a reported large earthquake occurring but not registered in the records of the Japan Meteorological Agency, and the number of missing persons not matching the student list.

Your first day at a new school.
You have just finished greeting your classmates and are seated in front of them, taking a curious look.
Class is almost over and recess is about to begin.

At first glance, it looks like an ordinary high school. But...
Aogami High School has had its share of so-called school ghost stories.

One of them is that "if you don't treat the new student well, bad luck will happen". And then...
